lessonTitle: 64. Practical ways to draw parallel lines
lessonTitleEnglish: Practical ways to draw parallel lines
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: To draw parallels, slide a set square along a ruler; its edge keeps the same angle with the ruler, so the lines are parallel.
stages.headlineEnglish: To draw parallels, slide a set square along a ruler; its edge keeps the same angle with the ruler, so the lines are parallel.

stages.headline: This relies on the test with equal corresponding angles; draftsmen also use a T-square.
stages.headlineEnglish: This relies on the test with equal corresponding angles; draftsmen also use a T-square.

stages.headline: On the ground parallels are set out with right angles: two lines perpendicular to a third are parallel.
stages.headlineEnglish: On the ground parallels are set out with right angles: two lines perpendicular to a third are parallel.
